key_insight: Ideal CSLDG achieves optimal O(h^{K+1}) L² accuracy for conservative transport in time-dependent compressible flows, avoiding the apparent order loss in conventional error estimates.
engineering_relevance: The result strengthens accuracy guarantees for high-order transport discretizations relevant to computational flow simulations, including compressible velocity fields.
method: Express each ideal update as exact conservative transport followed by L² projection onto the DG space.
Construct analysis-only local correctors using strict contraction of a reference-cell transport-projection operator.
Control flow-map approximation through weak integral moments to obtain an O(h^{K+2}) one-step residual.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a theoretical optimal-error proof for P^K approximations with standard L²-projected initial data, not numerical benchmarks or experimental validation.
watch_item: The proof assumes exact characteristic maps and upstream regions, uniform Cartesian meshes, fixed Δt/h, and local Courant components uniformly separated from integers.
paper_title: Optimal L^2 Error Estimates for CSLDG Ideal Numerical Solutions in Time-Dependent Compressible Periodic Flows
